policy: Hosts whose liveness cannot be established from GitHub-hosted runners. A permanent HTTP status from one of these hosts is reported as unverifiable rather than broken. Every entry must record evidence that the resource is genuinely reachable from a normal client, and a manual verification date that tests/test_unverifiable_hosts.py requires to stay within review_interval_days. This is not a way to silence a dead link: if a URL on one of these hosts is actually gone, the next manual review must catch it and the entry must be removed once the host becomes checkable again.

hosts.reason: Answers GitHub-hosted runners with HTTP 404 under sustained load, including for documents that exist. The status is indistinguishable from a withdrawn publication, so the live gate cannot judge this host.
hosts.evidence: Across four CI runs the failing set changed every time (800-92/final, then 800-92/r1/ipd and 800-122/final, then 800-122/final plus 800-34/r1/final) while the other NIST citations in the same run passed. Every failing URL returned HTTP 200 from a normal client, both with the audit User-Agent and a browser User-Agent. Host pacing at one request per second and three browser-agent confirmations spaced 2s, 5s and 15s did not clear it.

hosts.reason: Answers GitHub-hosted runners with HTTP 404 for pages that exist. A 404 is normally the one status this gate can trust as evidence of rot, so an unreachable-but-present page on this host is indistinguishable from a withdrawn article and the live gate cannot judge it.
hosts.evidence: The Technology Radar entry /radar/techniques/production-data-in-test-environments returned HTTP 404 from a GitHub-hosted runner on 2026-08-20, failing PR #219 which changes only api/ and no Question content. The same URL returned HTTP 200 from a normal client on the same day across all four combinations the checker can use: HEAD and GET, with the audit User-Agent and with the browser User-Agent. The status therefore tracks the client network rather than the resource, and no retry or User-Agent change reaches it.
